title: Heating a diatomic gas at constant pressure
caption: Heating 2 mol by 50 K at constant pressure takes Q = nC_pΔT = 2909 J. Of this ΔU = nC_VΔT = 2078 J raises the internal energy and W = nRΔT = 831 J is the work of expanding: C_p = C_V + R, so 29% of the heat becomes work (γ = 7/5).
alt: Energy flow: 2909 J of heat in, 2078 J to internal energy and 831 J to work done by the gas.
description: Heat supplied at constant pressure: Q = 2 × (5R/2 + R) × 50 = 2909 J.
Work: W = pΔV = nRΔT = 2 × 8.31 × 50 = 831 J. ΔU + W = Q.
